news.title: Got a fake OpenSea phishing email !
news.summary:
I don't know if this is the right place to post, but I got a phishing email from a fake OpenSea account telling me that I have a 1.85 ETH bid on one of my NFTs.

(Common, bro, bids are like $10 maximum in these hard times for NFTs.)

The email is insulting. It's clear that it's not an original OpenSea email. bro, I've already been scammed, but not like that...

The sender is a normal Gmail account.

For the moment, I haven't done anything
